description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kahengama, Kuruvita D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620274
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determinations for specific land parcels, including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and land classifications. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and focuses on land ownership and title settlement, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
